title: Page 10
content_zh:
“我信你，但是，你……你还是回京吧，我这辈子都不想再嫁，咱们还是像以前那样当知己，那时不是很快乐吗？”初荷困难的说，她不要兰泗娶了人人都可说闲话的皇族遗孀，她不要兰泗连带受到轻蔑。
兰泗将她手紧紧抓起来贴在他心口。“你是要我将心削出来给你瞧，你才愿意吗？”
初荷不住摇头。“你别说了，我们不可能的。别再说了，好好保重身体。”
她没办法再说下去，因为兰泗忽然一把将她抱住，脸就埋在她肩颈处，激动得整个身体轻颤着。
“你铁了心拒绝我是吗？早知如此，我阿玛那日拔剑要劈，我就该伸长脖子让他劈死还图个干净！”兰泗语气激动而哽咽，这几句话几乎是在初荷耳边讲的，让她听来更是震撼。
“你、你阿玛竟然……”初荷简直不敢想像当时的景况。“我不值得的，我只是个寡妇而已，我……”
兰泗抬起头来，神情有着前所未见的激烈。“倘若我说皇太后跟圣上都答允了呢？倘若我说此生非你不娶呢？”
“圣上皇太后怎、怎可能答应这门亲事？”初荷摇头不信。
“是真的！他们说不想再跟我这死心眼计较，由得我爱娶谁都行。圣上开了金口，我阿玛额娘还有反对的余地吗？”兰泗看出初荷的动摇，登时难以克制的轻轻拂了下她耳边的发。“我怎可能拿这样的事骗你？”
“但是，雪兰英公主怎么办？皇太后肯定气恼极了。”初荷担心着。
“你担心皇太后、担心是圣上、担心雪兰英，却独独没担心我吗？你就不怕我为你伤心欲绝吗？”兰泗说得恳切，那认真的眼神让初荷不舍。
她当然担心他，她最担心的人就是他啊！担心他过得不好，担心他受到众多长辈责难，担心他受人议论，担心他为此而伤心……
初荷直直望着他，原本打定主意要拒绝到底的那股决心开始动摇。
“初荷，你就忍心弃我而去？”他低低的嚷着，那好听的嗓音像是一种魅惑之声。
只是……
“我该狠心弃你而去的。”初荷在他惊愕受伤的眸光中，看见浅浅笑着的自己。“你竟跟郑奇山联合起来扯谎骗我，说什么圣上要让宗人府办你，害我、害我……”
她涨红脸，说不下去。
“害你不顾一切急奔出城？”兰泗也笑了。“倘若不这样扯谎，你肯见我吗？”
初荷笑着不肯答，但那带着羞怯的笑意却回答了一切。这一笑，没了幽结的心事；这一笑，是她终于卸下心防，是她对他情感的回应。
兰泗痴痴看着这抹笑，知道初荷终于不再躲避，一时之间心口涌起感动万千，不由得头一低，轻轻贴上她嘴唇，发现她没抗拒之后，两手深深将她抱进怀里。这一吻，更深了。

第10章(2)
“你说，要是你家福晋发现有个小丫头竟然敢偷看，会不会破天荒的发起脾气来？”
大门外，两个人贼兮兮的将脸贴在门缝上，看得脸红心跳。
“要是贝勒爷发现是你起的头，肯定史无前例的剥了你的皮。”
丽儿不服气的压低声音嚷嚷，眼睛却没离开，仍是盯着吻得难分难舍的两个主子。
这就是亲嘴吗？曾经听几个年纪大的嬷嬷提过，男人喜欢一个女人的时候就会这样，没想到真正发生在眼前时，竟让人看得心儿乱跳，紧张不已；尤其兰泗贝勒是那样俊挺飘逸，小姐又是如此含情脉脉、羞怯动人。
“什么叫做我起的头？是你先看的吧？”
小总管扯扯丽儿衣袖，十分不满的抗议着，不过视线很快又移回主子身上。他在兰泗贝勒身边伺候多年，还没见过这个向来斯文有礼的贝勒爷这么痴迷的吻人，他还以为这主子有洁癖呢，如今看他们似乎离不开对方的嘴唇，那应该是顾不得什么洁净干爽的鸟事了吧！
相较于大门外两人的鬼祟，关起门扉的两人却是一阵缠绵。
许久，两人才轻喘着气，改为深深凝望对方。
“你是什么时候发现我让郑奇山骗你？”仍喘着，但兰泗始终好奇。
向来都是这样，他对初荷聪明的脑袋始终感到惊奇。
初荷微微一笑，小脸上仍有方才激动拥吻而起的红潮。“我从马车上奔下来时就想到了。因为倘若你真如郑奇山所说急着赶回北京，又怎会才刚出城就停在驿站休息呢？只是．我那时一心只想见上你一面，即使知道你是在骗我，还是跑进驿站里来了。”
“初荷，我的初荷总是如此冰雪聪明。”兰泗低喃，语气像是倾心，又像是怜惜。
初荷听他说得情真意切，感动得几乎要掉泪。她发现自己开始喜欢当他的心上人，她开始眷恋他时而浅尝、时而深狂的亲吻，以及他时而轻柔、时而用力的拥抱，她……不要再只是当他的知己了。
“我以为向来气节高雅、文质彬彬的兰泗贝勒，该是冰清玉洁举止合乎于礼，怎么会……”怎么会这样吻人。
初荷咬着下唇，说不出后话。
但兰泗像是知道她想说些什么。“你是说冰清玉洁的兰泗贝勒怎会这么吻你？初荷，我承认自己是死心眼，但不是和尚。”说着说着，兰泗便笑了。
“你笑起来真好看，我真爱瞧这笑脸。”她凝神看着兰泗，心神悸动．竟然脱口而出如此露骨的告白。
兰泗被她蕴含情愫的模样给触动，又低头要吻，可没想到初荷竟忽然将他推开。

“所以，郑奇山说王爷将你打得半死，好几天下不了床，这也是骗我的？”
兰泗愣住，看初荷满脸指控，嗓音也比之前说话还要大声，不由得扯扯眉眼，思索着该如何善后。
“你可知道我有多担心？”她着实气恼。
“如果你介意这个谎，那我回京后闹点事让阿玛真的将我打得半死，这样可好？”他十足认真的说。
“你若真这么做，我就再也不理你了！”初荷虽然知道他是在说笑，仍是气得瞪大眼睛。
“以后你说什么我都依，就别跟我计较这一回了，好吗？”兰泗在她耳边轻轻说着。
初荷小小声应了一下，算是应允了。
她如何能责怪兰泗扯谎？他所做的这一切，都只是为了追求心中的悸动，就像她，奔下马车时明明已意识到了被欺骗，却仍是奋不顾身的闯进去。
两人吻着，一个没了平日的冷静隐忍，一个没了向来的清磊朗然，吻得难以割舍，心醉神驰。
大门外，丽儿和小总管苦恼不已，不知何时才能打断两个主子；但……这不打断不行啊，只因驿站外越来越多人纳闷观望着，人人议论纷纷里头究竟发生了什么事，怎么不能进去啊？
细雨纷飞，让初春气候添了点舒爽，不过也多了凉意。
王府书房内，一道高瘦的身影坐在窗边，一手支着光洁的额头，一于把玩着黑色棋子，晶亮如星的双眸盯着棋盘，正思索着下一步该如何走。
一个带着笑意的年轻少妇端着茶具走进来，慢条斯理的帮他沏茶，还递到嘴边。
“喝吧，歇会儿。”这人难得放假两天，竟这么执着，非得破了这盘棋局。
“你的棋艺真是越来越高明了，这一局竟设得如此精妙有趣。”他抬起头来，露出清朗好看的微笑，却见初荷视线停在书桌上的一张纸条。
“桌上这什么？你下午写的吗？”她好奇挪步过去看。

"I believe you, but you... you should go back to Beijing. I don't want to get married again in this life. We should still be close friends like before. Wasn't it very happy then?" Chu He said with difficulty. She didn't want Lan Si to marry a royal widow who everyone could gossip about, and she didn't want Lan Si to be scorned.
Lan Si held her hand tightly and put it against his heart. "Do you want me to cut my heart out and show it to you?"
Chu He couldn't help but shake his head. "Stop talking, we can't do it. Stop talking and take care of yourself."
She couldn't say any more, because Lan Si suddenly hugged her and buried his face in her shoulder and neck, making his whole body tremble with excitement.
"Are you determined to reject me? If I had known this, if I, Ama, had drawn my sword to strike that day, I should have stretched my neck to let him strike me cleanly!" Lan Si's tone was filled with emotion and choked with sobs. These words were almost spoken in Chu He's ears, which made her even more shocked.
"You, your Ama actually..." Chu He simply couldn't imagine the scene at that time. "I'm not worthy, I'm just a widow, I..."
Lan Si raised her head, her expression more intense than ever before. "What if I say that both the Queen Mother and the Holy Emperor agree? What if I say that I will not marry anyone but you in this life?"
"How, how could the Holy Empress Dowager agree to this marriage?" Chu He shook his head in disbelief.
"It's true! They said they don't want to care about me anymore, so I can marry whoever I want. The Holy Father has given me the golden mouth. Do I still have room to object?" Lan Si saw Chu He's wavering and could not restrain herself from brushing the hair beside her ear. "How could I lie to you about something like this?"
"But what about Princess Xue Lanying? The Queen Mother must be very angry." Chu He was worried.
"You're worried about the Queen Mother, the Holy Emperor, and Xue Lanying, but you're not worried about me? Aren't you afraid that I'll be heartbroken for you?" Lan Si said sincerely, and her serious eyes made Chu He reluctant to leave.
Of course she was worried about him, the person she worried about the most was him! Worried that he will not live well, worried that he will be criticized by many elders, worried that he will be discussed by others, worried that he will be sad because of it...
Chu He looked straight at him, her original determination to refuse to the end began to waver.
"Chu He, do you have the heart to abandon me?" He shouted in a low voice, his pleasant voice sounding like a charm.
Just...
"I should have cruelly abandoned you." Chu He saw herself smiling slightly in his shocked and hurt eyes. "You actually joined forces with Zheng Qishan to lie to me, saying that the Holy Emperor wanted the clan government to deal with you, harm me, harm me..."
She blushed and couldn't speak.
"Making you run out of the city desperately?" Lan Si also smiled. "If you didn't lie like this, would you be willing to see me?"
Chu He smiled and refused to answer, but that shy smile answered everything. This smile removed Youjie's worries; this smile meant that she finally let go of her guard, and was her response to his emotions.
Lan Si looked at the smile longingly, knowing that Chu He finally stopped hiding. She was so moved that she couldn't help but lower her head and gently press her lips to hers. When she found that she didn't resist, he hugged her deeply with both hands. This kiss became deeper.
Chapter 10(2)
"Tell me, if your Fujin finds out that a little girl dares to peek, will he lose his temper for the first time?"
Outside the door, two people pressed their faces against the crack of the door in a sly manner, their faces red and their hearts beating.
"If Master Beile finds out that it was you who started this, he will definitely skin you like never before."
Li'er lowered her voice and shouted unconvinced, but her eyes did not leave, still staring at the two masters who were kissing each other inseparably.
Is this a kiss? I once heard several older mothers mention that men will behave like this when they like a woman. Unexpectedly, when it actually happened in front of them, it made people's hearts beat wildly and made them nervous; especially Lan Sibeile was so handsome and elegant,The young lady is so affectionate, shy and charming.
"What do you mean I started it? You looked at it first, right?"
The young steward tugged on Li'er's sleeves and protested with great dissatisfaction, but his eyes quickly returned to his master. He has been serving Lansi Beile for many years, and he has never seen the always polite and courteous Master Beile kissing someone so obsessively. He thought that this master had a mysophobia, but now it seems that they can't live without each other's lips, so they probably don't care about anything clean and dry!
Compared with the sneakiness of the two people outside the door, the two people behind closed doors were entangled for a while.
After a long time, the two of them breathed lightly and stared at each other deeply.
"When did you find out that I asked Zheng Qishan to lie to you?" Lan Si was still breathing, but she was always curious.
It had always been like this, and he was always amazed by Chuhe's clever mind.
Chu He smiled slightly, her face still flushed with excitement from the kiss. "I thought about it when I ran down from the carriage. Because if you were really in a hurry to get back to Beijing as Zheng Qishan said, how could you stop at the inn to rest just after leaving the city? It's just that at that time, I just wanted to see you. Even though I knew you were lying to me, I still ran into the inn."
"Chuhe, my Chuhe is always so ice-cold and smart." Lan Si murmured, her tone sounding like admiration and pity.
Chuhe heard what he said sincerely and was so moved that she almost shed tears. She found that she began to like being his sweetheart, she began to be attached to his sometimes shallow and sometimes deep passionate kisses, and his sometimes gentle and sometimes forceful hugs. She... no longer just wanted to be his confidant.
"I thought that Lan Sibeile, who has always been elegant and polite, should be pure and clean and behave according to etiquette. How could he..." How could he kiss someone like this.
Chuhe bit her lower lip, unable to say anything else.
But Lan Si seemed to know what she wanted to say. "You mean how could the innocent Lan Sibeile kiss you like this? Chu He, I admit that I am stubborn, but I am not a monk." As he spoke, Lan Si smiled.
"You look so pretty when you smile. I really love seeing that smiling face." She looked at Lan Si intently, her heart palpitating. He actually blurted out such an explicit confession.
Lan Si was touched by her affectionate look and lowered her head for a kiss. Unexpectedly, Chu He suddenly pushed him away.
"So, Zheng Qishan also lied to me when he said that the prince beat you half to death and that you couldn't get out of bed for several days?"
Lan Si was stunned, seeing Chu He's face full of accusations and her voice louder than before. She couldn't help but twitch her eyebrows and think about how to deal with the aftermath.
"Do you know how worried I am?" She was really angry.
"If you mind this lie, how about I make some trouble when I return to Beijing and let Amma beat me half to death?" He said seriously.
"If you really do this, I will never pay attention to you again!" Although Chu He knew he was joking, his eyes widened in anger.
"I will obey whatever you say from now on, so don't worry about me this time, okay?" Lan Si whispered in her ear.
Chuhe responded in a small voice, which was regarded as an agreement.
How could she blame Lan Si for lying? All he did was just to pursue the throbbing in his heart, just like her, when she ran out of the carriage, she had clearly realized that she had been deceived, but she still rushed in regardless of her own safety.
The two kissed, one lost his usual calmness and forbearance, the other lost his usual openness and openness, the kiss was inseparable, and they were ecstatic.
Outside the gate, Li'er and the young steward were in distress, not knowing when to interrupt the two masters; but... this would not work without interrupting, because more and more people outside the inn were watching in confusion, and everyone was talking about what happened inside, why couldn't they go in?
The drizzle is falling, making the early spring weather a little more comfortable, but also a little cooler.
In the study room of the palace, a tall and thin figure sat by the window, holding his smooth forehead with one hand and playing with the black chess pieces, staring at him with bright eyes like stars.He was looking at the chessboard, thinking about what to do next.
A smiling young woman came in with a tea set, slowly helped him make tea, and put it to his mouth.
"Drink and take a rest." This man rarely had two days off, but he was so persistent that he had to break the chess game.
"Your chess skills are really getting better and better. This game is so clever and interesting." He raised his head and showed a clear and beautiful smile, but he saw Chuhe's eyes stopped on a piece of paper on the desk.
"What's this on the table? Did you write it this afternoon?" She moved over curiously to take a look.
